title: DualGauge: Automated Joint Security-Functionality Benchmarking of Specification-Only Code Generation by LLMs and Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2511.20709v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based coding agents are now used to generate code from natural-language specifications, yet ensuring such code is both functionally correct and secure remains a challenge. We present DualGauge, the first fully automated framework for jointly evaluating correctness and security of specification-only code generation, supported by DualGauge-Bench, a language-agnostic benchmark of 307 coding tasks each paired with functional and security tests derived from the same specification. Evaluating 10 representative LLMs across Python, C++, and JavaScript, we find that functional correctness substantially overestimates reliable code generation: even the strongest model remains below 15% joint security-functionality success in every language. translated_title: DeepFuzz：通过语法感知的定向变异对深度学习库进行系统化模糊测试
translated_abstract: 深度学习（DL）库在支撑深度学习应用方面发挥着关键作用；然而，这些库中的缺陷可能导致严重后果。现有的针对深度学习库的模糊测试技术主要通过随机变异预定义的范围和形状，或利用原始代码的中间表示来生成输入张量，因此无法生成能够充分探索深度学习库内部代码结构的高质量输入。本文提出了DeepFuzz，一种新颖的语法感知模糊测试框架，用于对深度学习库进行系统且全面的测试。具体而言，DeepFuzz定制了一种上下文无关文法，以准确表示深度学习库中张量生成操作的语法，并进一步采用定向变异策略来生成结构丰富的输入张量，避免探索过程中遇到的长期低效问题。我们对DeepFuzz的评估涵盖了两个主流深度学习库：TensorFlow和PyTorch。在七天的测试周期内，DeepFuzz发现了129个此前未知的缺陷（TensorFlow中119个，PyTorch中10个），其中47个已被相应开发者确认并修复，证明了其在真实场景中的有效性。此外，DeepFuzz显著优于三个最先进的基线方法，并在长时间内展现出持续的测试有效性。
tldr: DeepFuzz提出了一种语法感知的模糊测试框架，通过定制上下文无关文法与定向变异策略系统性测试深度学习库，在TensorFlow和PyTorch中发现了129个此前未知的缺陷，并显著优于现有最先进方法。
en_tdlr: DeepFuzz introduces a grammar-aware fuzzing framework with directed mutation that systematically tests deep learning libraries, discovering 129 previously unknown defects in TensorFlow and PyTorch while significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.
